name: Hajima Sora
source:
A young man who lives in the Cocoon near Sensoji Temple in Asakusa, Taito Ward. He has synesthesia, which allows him to see colors in sounds, and can he discern other people's feelings by the difference in those colors. He expresses his unique worldview through oil paintings, but is not well known. 

[Translated from in-game profile]
